breakout_confirmation.promotion_rule: Promote only when pressure-aware breakout confirmation beats the baseline breakout control on follow-through, false-break reduction, and execution stability rather than merely producing more triggers.
breakout_confirmation.differentiated_claim: Pressure-aware breakout confirmation should improve follow-through and reduce fakeouts relative to naive breakout triggers.
breakout_confirmation.why_now_logic: Breakouts only deserve promotion when pressure build-up and release quality are jointly credible.
breakout_confirmation.execution_realism_assumptions: Entry quality degrades during expansion; slippage and thin-book traps matter.
breakout_confirmation.rejection_rule: Reject if confirmation logic removes too many good breakouts or fails to reduce fakeouts after realistic costs.
negative_knowledge_targets: compression states that do not release cleanly

breakout_execution_gated.promotion_rule: Promote only if execution gating materially removes low-quality breakouts, reduces slippage damage, and preserves enough high-quality trades to outperform ungated breakout variants.
breakout_execution_gated.differentiated_claim: Execution gating should improve realized quality by vetoing trades with hidden hazard rather than by adding directional prediction.
breakout_execution_gated.why_now_logic: Execution damage can dominate edge during fast expansion regimes.
breakout_execution_gated.execution_realism_assumptions: Slippage, adverse selection, and hidden liquidity failure are first-order risks.
breakout_execution_gated.rejection_rule: Reject if gating acts as decorative friction and does not materially reduce bad trades.
negative_knowledge_targets: hazard conditions with no realized damage

equilibrium_recenter.promotion_rule: Promote only when drift-aware or tail-persistence recenter variants beat the raw z-score control on contamination resistance, adverse excursion, and recenter efficiency rather than simply fading more extremes.
equilibrium_recenter.differentiated_claim: Drift-aware or persistence-aware recenter logic should beat generic stretch fading by resisting contamination.
equilibrium_recenter.why_now_logic: Ordinary stretch is too generic; reversion needs contamination awareness to survive.
equilibrium_recenter.execution_realism_assumptions: Mean-reversion entries can suffer fast adverse excursion when acceptance continues.
equilibrium_recenter.rejection_rule: Reject if the strategy keeps fading genuine trend acceptance or cannot improve adverse excursion.
negative_knowledge_targets: persistent tail occupancy that does not revert
drift states that reclassify as trend

shock_reversal.promotion_rule: Promote only when shock-reversal logic captures repeatable abnormal impulse decay with tight risk and avoids event-driven continuation traps better than generic reversion baselines.
shock_reversal.differentiated_claim: Shock reversal should capture repeatable impulse decay rather than blindly fading every abnormal move.
shock_reversal.why_now_logic: Only some abnormal moves decay cleanly enough to offer controlled reversal entries.
shock_reversal.execution_realism_assumptions: Fast reversal windows are sensitive to latency, spreads, and fast invalidation needs.
shock_reversal.rejection_rule: Reject if event-driven continuation dominates and reversal precision collapses.
negative_knowledge_targets: reversals that only work in thin samples

trend_alignment.promotion_rule: Promote only when pullback-quality and coherence-aware continuation outperforms generic momentum-alignment controls on trend retention, drawdown containment, and late-entry penalty reduction.
trend_alignment.differentiated_claim: Continuation should improve when path quality and pullback structure are better than naive momentum alignment.
trend_alignment.why_now_logic: Not all momentum persistence is tradable; path coherence determines continuation quality.
trend_alignment.execution_realism_assumptions: Late entries and trend exhaustion can destroy expectancy after costs.
trend_alignment.rejection_rule: Reject if coherence filters lag too much or if cost-adjusted edge collapses.
negative_knowledge_targets: pullbacks that looked healthy but failed structurally

trend_reacceleration.promotion_rule: Promote only if reacceleration entries after orderly pauses improve timing, reduce chase behavior, and show cleaner renewal selectivity than continuous trend-following baselines.
trend_reacceleration.differentiated_claim: Pause-to-renewal entries should improve timing and reduce chase behavior relative to continuous continuation logic.
trend_reacceleration.why_now_logic: A clean pause can offer better timing than always-on exposure when renewal is selective.
trend_reacceleration.execution_realism_assumptions: Renewal entries are vulnerable to fake restarts and degraded fills during fast re-expansion.
trend_reacceleration.rejection_rule: Reject if pause classification is noisy or if renewal logic does not improve timing.
negative_knowledge_targets: renewals that only trigger after exhaustion

volatility_transition.promotion_rule: Promote only if volatility-transition logic captures orderly expansion while filtering chaotic releases and hidden-instability traps better than plain breakout or continuation templates.
volatility_transition.differentiated_claim: Volatility transition logic should capture orderly state change while filtering chaos and mature expansion.
volatility_transition.why_now_logic: The edge depends on recognizing clean transition quality, not volatility level alone.
volatility_transition.execution_realism_assumptions: Transitions can gap or slip quickly, so execution conditions affect realized edge.
volatility_transition.rejection_rule: Reject if transition states are too noisy or if fake-release filtering adds no value.
negative_knowledge_targets: compression states that explode without follow-through
transition states that are indistinguishable from noise

execution_aware_overlay.promotion_rule: Promote only if the execution-aware overlay materially reduces bad trades, adverse selection, and trap entries while preserving the majority of high-quality opportunities from upstream directional systems.
execution_aware_overlay.differentiated_claim: Execution-aware overlays should add value primarily by preventing bad trades with hidden hazard.
execution_aware_overlay.why_now_logic: In friction-heavy regimes, avoiding bad fills can add more value than adding more entries.
execution_aware_overlay.execution_realism_assumptions: Slippage, liquidity holes, and adverse selection dominate realized outcomes.
execution_aware_overlay.rejection_rule: Reject if opportunity cost exceeds the quality gain from avoided trades.
failure_archetypes: hazard signals with no realized damage
negative_knowledge_targets: filters that only look good in backtest
hazard conditions that are not execution-relevant
